comparisonTitle: Cafe Crisa Beverage Menu Nutritional Comparison
summary: This menu presents a wide range of beverages, from plain teas and fresh juices to heavily sweetened dessert drinks loaded with condensed milk and syrups. Given your high calorie, sodium, and added sugar intake, prioritising unsweetened or lightly prepared drinks is critical to avoid worsening metabolic strain.

groups.groupName: Tier 1: Fresh Unsweetened Juices & Coconut Water
groups.comparisonSentence: Unlike the heavy dessert bowls and syrupy iced drinks, these fresh juices and coconut water provide essential potassium and fiber with zero added sugars.
groups.message: These pure fruit and vegetable options help address your dietary fiber deficit while supplying natural potassium. They contain no added sugars or saturated fats, making them the most metabolically sound choice on the menu, though you should still be mindful of natural fruit sugars.
groups.orderingTip: Request pure coconut water or vegetable juices with absolutely no added sugar, syrup, or condensed milk.

groups.groupName: Tier 2: Light Fruit Juices & Plain Teas
groups.comparisonSentence: Compared to the highly dense dessert soups, these standard juices and teas have fewer total calories but still require sugar adjustments.
groups.message: These beverages offer moderate hydration and vitamins. However, standard versions often include liquid cane sugar which will contribute to your existing added sugar overload. Opt for minimal or zero added sweetener to protect your glycemic control.
groups.orderingTip: Order with half-sugar or ask for sugar to be served separately so you can control your intake.

groups.groupName: Tier 3: Flavored Syrups, Yakult & Noodle Drinks
groups.comparisonSentence: These flavored and syrup-laden beverages exceed your daily sugar thresholds faster than fresh juices due to artificial additives and syrups.
groups.message: Packed with flavored syrups, jellies, and sweetened milks, these drinks significantly worsen your added sugar and carbohydrate surpluses. While lower in saturated fat than dessert bowls, their glycemic load remains a major metabolic concern.
groups.orderingTip: Limit these options entirely. If consumed, request no added flavored syrups and remove jelly toppings.

groups.groupName: Tier 4: Condensed Milk & Heavy Dessert Bowls
groups.comparisonSentence: Unlike fresh juices, these heavy dessert bowls are calorie-dense bombs loaded with condensed milk, coconut cream, and excessive saturated fats.
groups.message: These mixed dessert soups and heavy avocado blends deliver massive surges of saturated fat and refined sugar, directly conflicting with your high calorie (39% over) and saturated fat (38% over) targets. They pose an acute metabolic risk and should be strictly avoided.
groups.orderingTip: Strictly avoid all Es Campur, Sop Buah, and avocado-durian dessert bowls due to high condensed milk and saturated fat content.

recommendedOption: Tier 1: Fresh Unsweetened Juices & Coconut Water
